## HISTORY AND PHYSICAL
Date: 09/05/2026 13:00
## CC
Watery diarrhea x 5 days, abdominal cramping
## HPI
61 y/o M, unhoused (sleeping at a bus shelter, uses day center showers), completed 10-day course of clindamycin for a dental abscess ending ~1 week ago. Now with 8-10 watery stools per day, lower abdominal cramping, low-grade fever, poor PO intake, lightheaded on standing. No blood in stool.
ED: T 100.6F, HR 108, BP 102/64, WBC 16.8, Cr 1.4 (baseline unknown).
## PMH
- HTN (not on meds)
- Dental abscess 08/2026
## Meds PTA

pages.title: History and Physical - page 2
pages.text:
## Exam
Gen: tired, dry mucous membranes, AOx4
Abd: soft, mild diffuse lower abdominal tenderness, no rebound, no distension, active bowel sounds
## Data
C. difficile PCR: POSITIVE. C. difficile toxin EIA: POSITIVE.
CT A/P: mild colonic wall thickening consistent with colitis, no megacolon, no perforation
## Assessment/Plan
1. C. difficile infection, non-severe to moderate (WBC 16.8, Cr 1.4) after recent clindamycin
- Oral vancomycin 125 mg PO four times daily x 10 days
- CONTACT ENTERIC PRECAUTIONS - soap and water hand hygiene, dedicated bathroom
2. AKI due to dehydration - IV fluids
3. Dispo: unhoused, CM consult
Signed: Vikram Shah, MD 09/05/2026 14:20
